lines.en: label day295:
scene tsubasaofficevisit1
: Do you mind if I ask why you’re sitting on my desk?
: Would you prefer if I sat on your lap instead?
: I mean, kind of. Yeah.
I find myself killing time in my office with Chika after another average and unexciting day of[school].
And by “I find myself” I mean that Chika takes it upon herself to call out of her shift tonight so she can spend more time with me.
Which is fine and everything, don’t get me wrong-
But I’d like to prevent the possibility of her little sister starving to death if I have anything to do with it.
I know, I know. I’m such a great guy.
: So...thanks for ghosting on me after sneaking into Ami’s dressing room the other day.
: It is not “sneaking” if you specifically told me I was allowed to do that.
: Okay, so maybe not “sneaking,” but it was still kind of weird.
: Like, she’s your [niece]. And I’m not putting the blame on you or anything since it was clearly something you got dragged into-
: But she should kinda like...back off, shouldn't she? It's totally weird.
: Why are we even talking about this right now?
scene tsubasaofficevisit2
: Idunno, but maybe we should use this as an opportunity to segue into exactly why you were in the dressing room with her.
: Are we really planning on doing a winter beach trip?
: Apparently we are. I hope you enjoy slowly freezing to death over the course of two days and one night.
scene tsubasaofficevisit3
: Fine by me since I can always sneak into my boyfriend’s room at night and ask him to keep me warm~
: Yes, that’s a completely safe idea and I’m sure that none of your seventeen other classmates will question you mysteriously disappearing in the middle of the night.
scene tsubasaofficevisit4
: It’ll probably be like nineteen by then, though. Right?
: ...Does that make it any better?
: I mean, at this point, I don’t know if it would really make it worse.
scene tsubasaofficevisit2
: We’ve just gotta practice being sneaky or something. And obvs that starts with me coming to say hi and sitting on your desk during office hours.
: And if you just so happen to look up my skirt or something, I can just pretend I didn’t see.
: Isn’t your girlfriend great?
Please stop calling yourself that before it gets any more dangerous...
: Wait, how did you even know about the new transfers?
scene tsubasaofficevisit5
: Uhh...I don’t know?
: Makoto probably told Miku. And then Miku probably told some other people because she’s Miku. And then it somehow found its way to me.
: Do you know who the transfers are, though?
: Not really. I just know one of them is apparently a sketch and is going to give Yumi a run for her money as class delinquent.
So I see Makoto spared no details (Of what little details are actually available) regarding Yasu’s expected character.
: Got it.
: Oh, and also, if Makoto ever asks you if you and I went to a petting zoo together, the answer is yes.
scene tsubasaofficevisit4
: Got it!
: Really? You’re not even going to question that?
: Nah. I’m sure you’ve got your reasons.
Wow. Maybe Chika actually would be a good girlfriend and I-
Wait. What am I even thinking right now?
scene tsubasaofficevisit6
A knock on the door breaks the flow of our conversation and-
: Come in!
: Wait, you can’t just invite people into my-
scene tsubasaofficevisit7
: Chika? What are you doing in here?
: I’m not interrupting something personal, am I?
: Nah. I’m just talking to Sensei about the petting zoo we went to that one time.
Smooth.
: Right...Well, if that’s the case, this would probably be a good time to inform you that you’re not allowed to be sitting on his desk.
if makotolust10 == True:
Bold words for someone who literally bent over the table in the center of the room for me before.
else:
Poor Makoto. She doesn’t realize that we’re definitely going to have sex on this desk sometime in the future.
: It’s the misuse of[school] property and-
: Did you need something, Makoto?
scene tsubasaofficevisit8
: Um...if we’re just moving along, then yes. There was something I had to discuss with Sensei regarding our newest transfer student.
: Sensei, if you have a minute, would it be okay for me to bring in a visitor?
: A visitor? You mean one that isn’t Ms. Watabe or a student?
: Correct. Though, she does seem to be rather familiar with you based on her reference to you as the...and I apologize if I am misquoting this-
scene tsubasaofficevisit9
: The “WAP” man?...
: Wait! There’s only one person I know who would ever consistently misuse that word in that way!
: The...what man?
: Come in, Tsubasa!
scene tsubasaofficevisit10
: Chika, please stop inviting people into my office...
: I apologize. Did I come at a poor time?
: There’s no need to apologize, Miss Tsukioka. Thank you very much for taking the time out of your busy schedule to come here today.
scene tsubasaofficevisit11
: Oh, there’s no need to thank me for that. I can assure you I am very much not busy.
: In fact, just being able to traverse the halls of a quaint little[school] like this has been the most fun I’ve had in quite some time.
: She heard us have sex.
: Yes, Chika. I am aware.
: She heard us have sex...a lot.
: You know, maybe it’s time for you to head home and prevent Chinami from getting sick or something?
scene tsubasaofficevisit12
Chika hops off of the desk and joins Tsubasa and Makoto as they make their way to the front of it.

I highly doubt Chika is going to go home yet on account of her favorite MILF showing up (Which is assuming that Chika has a secret, ranked list of MILFs), but for a brief moment in time I breathe a sigh of relief.
: Oh, Chika! Wonderful. I haven’t seen you since the-
scene tsubasaofficevisit13
: Petting zoo.
: I beg your pardon?
: Is this more [young]person slang that I have yet to hear on the radio?
: Yup! Why are you here, though?
scene tsubasaofficevisit14
: Oh, allow me to answer that.
: In light of the recent sinkhole incident that struck Kumon-mi Academy, Miss Tsukioka has decided to enroll her daughter here at [kumon_mi_high].
: I may have subconsciously attempted to talk her out of it on multiple occasions as I’m not sure if our...capabilities will meet her daughter’s requirements, but-
scene tsubasaofficevisit15
: Oh, please...There’s no need to be so formal. I’m sure that this[school] will work wonders for my daughter and her education.
: It...could, under normal circumstances. But the circumstances of our classroom, which you have specifically requested for some reason, are anything but normal.
: It’s true. Our class is really weird.
scene tsubasaofficevisit16
: If I entrust my daughter’s future to you, are you going to let me down?
: Probably.
: Probably.
: Definitely.
: See?
: They’re just being humble, I’m sure.
: You recently took on the Nagasawa girl, didn’t you? Between her and my little tour guide here, that would mean you have the two highest scoring girls in the entire district.
scene tsubasaofficevisit17
: Right...
: I guess the days of me being the smartest girl in[school] are over now, huh?
: You’ll catch up in due time, dear. I was never quite fond of that Nagasawa girl to begin with.
: She is...quite peculiar.
scene tsubasaofficevisit18
: I’d also like it to be known that it wasn’t just the presence of those two bright, [young]stars that forced my hand in making this decision.
: What was it then? Because I was pretty confident my first impression was...not very good.
scene tsubasaofficevisit19
: It was what this girl right here had to say about you during a lengthy conversation at the petting zoo about the way you make her feel.
: That told me everything I needed to know about you as a teacher.
: And while your methods are certainly...unorthodox, I am going to assume that was simply due to the fact that it was a special occasion.
scene tsubasaofficevisit20
: My daughter does not have a very easy time...opening up to people.
: She is a wonderful [young_girl]...and extremely dedicated when it comes to both the family business as well as her academic life.
: But she has a history of being rather...uninspired when it comes to those who have been fortunate enough to teach her.
: And so, in knowing that you are able to see your students as more than just minds to mold, I’ve decided to take a leap of faith and put her in your hands.
scene tsubasaofficevisit21
: I can’t guarantee she’ll be entirely cooperative to begin with, but I can assure you that she is unreasonably kind at heart and wants nothing more than to fit in.
You know, only I would be lucky enough to somehow gain the trust of the wealthiest woman in Kumon-mi by audibly deflowering a girl the same age as her daughter in the room right next door.
: I mean...if that’s what you think is best for her, she can definitely hang out.
scene tsubasaofficevisit22
: Hang out. I love that! It’s so informal that it’s as if you don’t view your students as students at all.
: Yes. That exact principle is the single largest pillar in my teaching strategy.
: I mean...it’s certainly not not working?
: Yeah. Weirdly enough, having someone like Sensei around is the exact motivation I needed to really start putting myself back on track.
: And, if your daughter is anything at all like you, I’m sure that she and I will get along great.
scene tsubasaofficevisit23
: That would mean so much to me, dear. Please make her feel at home if at all possible.
: Of course! Anything for you, Tsubasa!
The gap between first and second place on Chika’s secret MILF ranking widens.
: Well...I guess that’s that, then.
: Miss Tsukioka just wanted to formally touch base with you and confirm that you were, indeed, the “WAP” man.
: I have decided to embrace my poor usage of the “WAP” and convert it into a multifunctional tool for describing good people!
: Cooooooool.
scene tsubasaofficevisit24
: So, would this Friday work as her first day in your class?
: We’re still in the process of relocating her to a second, smaller house in the area so the commute will be less strenuous on her, but we should be finished within the next day or two.
: You’re...getting her her own house?
: Of course. It’s the very least we can do to reward her for all of this.
: She was quite resistant to the idea at first, actually. But she eventually came around after seeing how many people were flocking to this[school].
: That’s great and all, but she could just move into the dorms instead. She doesn’t need a whole house.
: Ooooooh, I see. I see.
: But, what is a “dorm” exactly?
: It’s like...an apartment specifically designed for people attending[school].
: My, that sounds like it would be absolutely splendid once she’s ready for it.
: But I do think we should at least wait to see if she’s able to seamlessly transition into the actual[school] first before making a commitment like that.
: Hey, whatever works for you. She’s your daughter. I’m just some guy that's going to be around her pretty frequently from now on.
: Not too frequently, though. You’ve got...other obligations.
: Precisely. Like your paperwork and spending time showing your glorified secretary how much you appreciate all she does for you.
: Yup. Exactly what I’m talking about. Definitely not anything else.
: Oh my...I can feel the secondhand excitement bubbling up within me by the second.
: Perhaps I should also transfer into this[school]?
scene tsubasaofficevisit25
: Let’s just...focus on your daughter for right now instead...
scene black
The three girls leave the office moments later and I take a couple hours to actually do some paperwork before heading out myself.
I figure it’s the least I can do to not only lessen some of the burden on Makoto, but to reward her for putting together this entire rich girl transfer operation.
I just hope the process for our final student goes just as smoothly...
$ day295 = True
